cards.title: Partner's behavior at kids' sports matches straining relationship
cards.body: A 25-year relationship is tested when one partner's obnoxious conduct at their sons' football matches creates tension. Experts suggest finding the root cause of the anger rather than dismissing the behavior outright.

cards.title: Pediatrician: Human connection matters more than AI fears
cards.body: Rather than fixating on screens destroying childhood, focus on open conversations with your kids. In-person connection—not tech avoidance—is what children need most for healthy development.

cards.title: Why celebrating Halloween with kids creates lasting magic
cards.body: Halloween traditions rooted in centuries of cultural celebration offer parents a chance to create meaningful moments with children. Embracing seasonal activities like pumpkin decorating builds connection and childhood memories.

cards.title: Is protein powder safe for kids and teens?
cards.body: Parents considering supplements for active children should understand safety guidelines for young users. Experts weigh in on whether protein powder is appropriate for ages 12 and up.

cards.title: Conflict resolution skills help calm family tensions
cards.body: Teaching children and parents conflict resolution during October's awareness month can transform how families communicate. When even one person learns healthy communication, it benefits the entire household.
